title: The 5 Tallest Waterfalls on Earth, Ranked (#1 Is Hidden in a Jungle)

scenes.text: Five waterfalls fall almost a kilometer. Number one is hidden deep in a Venezuelan jungle.

scenes.label: Yumbilla Falls · 896 m
scenes.text: Number five: Yumbilla Falls in Peru. Eight hundred ninety-six meters, taller than two Eiffel Towers stacked.

scenes.label: Olo'upena Falls · 900 m
scenes.text: Number four: Olo'upena Falls in Hawaii. Nine hundred meters of falling water.

scenes.label: Tres Hermanas · 914 m
scenes.text: Number three: Tres Hermanas Falls in Peru. Its name means Three Sisters. Nine hundred fourteen meters tall.

scenes.label: Tugela Falls · 948 m
scenes.text: Number two: Tugela Falls in South Africa. Nearly nine hundred fifty meters, pouring off the Drakensberg mountains.

scenes.label: Angel Falls · 979 m
scenes.text: Number one: Angel Falls in Venezuela. Nine hundred seventy-nine meters, more than three thousand feet. The tallest on Earth.

description:
The five tallest waterfalls on Earth, ranked by overall height.
The winner is about three times the height of the Eiffel Tower and sits in a Venezuelan jungle.
Which waterfall would you most want to see?
first_comment: Which waterfall surprised you? What should we rank next?
